name: Anvilmar
summary: In Anvilmar, young Bronzebeard dwarves and displaced gnomes gather to train and prepare for the road ahead. The fortified outpost stands in snowy Coldridge Valley, in Dun Morogh, around a great stone forge.

sections.title: The Hearth of Coldridge
sections.body: At Anvilmar, a central forge burns within sturdy stone walls in the northern crags of Coldridge Valley. Class mentors and supply vendors are here, alongside veteran mountain mountaineers who drill recruits before they set out into the wider kingdom. Snowdrifts shelter the outpost, but Frostmane trolls and wild beasts prowl the frozen valley, keeping its defenders on guard.

sections.title: A Legacy of Iron and Trolls
sections.body: Anvilmar may take its name from High King Modimus Anvilmar, who ruled the dwarven clans before the War of the Three Hammers. The garrison keeps watch today, tending the forge fires as trolls and beasts roam the valley.

faq.answer: Anvilmar is a dwarven outpost in northern Coldridge Valley, in Dun Morogh. Newly recruited dwarves and gnomes gather there to train and prepare for the road ahead.
Anvilmar may be named for High King Modimus Anvilmar or his bloodline. Modimus ruled the dwarven clans before the War of the Three Hammers, but the outpost’s name has no confirmed origin.
Frostmane trolls and dangerous wildlife threaten Anvilmar. Wolves and wendigos roam the crags of Coldridge Valley.
Anvilmar has a forge, but no professional tradeskill trainers. To learn a craft, young recruits must travel farther into Dun Morogh, to places such as Kharanos or Ironforge.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you begin your journey at Anvilmar, an outpost that may bear the name of the ancient High King who once ruled the dwarven clans.
As a gnome taking shelter at Anvilmar, you find dwarven allies, warm hearths, and instructors who can help you adapt to the frozen wilderness.
